name: knowledge
description: Turns what a session taught into durable knowledge notes without shallow or misleading ones: triages the session for concepts, systems and mechanisms worth keeping, researches each in a read-only agent, checks every claim against its source in a clean-context reviewer, and drafts the note for approval. Store-agnostic (plain markdown by default, Basic Memory or any MCP-backed store by config) and source-agnostic (code, docs, tickets, web — whatever the project declares or has connected).
